PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester
